user.title: Connect to EMASESA
user.description: Enter the credentials of your EMASESA Oficina Online account (the same ones you use at emasesaonline.com).

2fa.title: Verification code
2fa.description: EMASESA has sent a verification code (SMS or email) to confirm this new device. Enter it below — this is only needed once: this device will then be remembered as trusted.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to EMASESA
reauth_confirm.description: EMASESA has stopped trusting this device and needs to verify it again. Enter your password to continue.

abort.already_configured: This EMASESA account is already configured.

carga_masiva.title: Manual bulk load
carga_masiva.description: Re-query EMASESA and rewrite the hourly statistic for the last N days. Use this to fill in the Energy dashboard history, or to fix a gap left by a previous load that failed partway through. This does not change any saved setting.

error.reauth_required: EMASESA has stopped trusting this device and needs to verify it again — reconnect the integration first (a reauthentication notification should appear), then retry the bulk load.

confirm.title: Delete the orphaned series

abort.ya_no_es_huerfana: This series no longer exists or is no longer orphaned, so there is nothing to delete.
abort.datos_invalidos: The issue does not contain the required data and will be removed.
abort.recorder_no_disponible: The statistics history could not be queried. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.tiempo_agotado: The delete command was sent, but the history has not confirmed that it finished. Check in a few minutes whether the series is still there and, if so, try again.
